annotations.title: Price of facts on request / move to fit

description: After a search: the price in credits of finding facts for chosen partial people and moving them to fit («перевести в подходящие», promote=true), or facts only (promote=false). Free, changes nothing; the answer's `credits` is the confirm_credits of start_facts_on_request, `skipped` the people it does not take and why. [REST: POST /api/tasks/{id}/manual/quote]

task_id.description: The search id (task id), e.g. from list_searches or create_search.
